text:
Audit findings (11 files reviewed; no build run). Ordered by severity.

**Critical**
1. `src/_includes/base.njk:8` – Canonical points to `staging.brightside-dental.example`, but the production origin is `www.brightside-dental.example` (`geo.config.json:1`, `sitemap.xml`, `robots.txt`). Every page tells search engines and AI crawlers that the staging host is the canonical one. Fix: build the canonical from the production origin, e.g. `https://www.brightside-dental.example{{ page.url }}`. Better still, put the origin in `src/_data/site.json` and use it everywhere.
2. `src/services.njk:5` – `noindex: true` on the main services page. The sitemap (`sitemap.xml:4`) lists it, which is a contradiction. The page is hidden from search and AI results, and it is your main commercial page. Fix: remove the flag.
3. `src/contact.njk:10` – The JSON-LD has a trailing comma after `"telephone"`, so it is invalid JSON and parsers will ignore the block. Fix: remove the comma. Also add `url`, `address` (PostalAddress, 12 Park Row, Leeds), `openingHours`, `image` and `sameAs`.

**High**
4. `src/team.njk:3-4` – No `description` front matter, so the meta description is empty (`base.njk:7` renders `content=""`). Fix: add a description. Also make the layout omit the tag when no description is set.
5. `src/index.njk:8` – The image points to `/img/reception.jpg`, but the repo has no `src/img` directory, and `.eleventy.js` doesn't copy images. Result: a broken image (404). Fix: add the file and `addPassthroughCopy('src/img')`. Add `width` and `height` attributes too.
6. `src/_includes/base.njk:2` – `<html>` has no `lang` attribute. Fix: `<html lang="en-GB">`.
7. `src/_includes/base.njk:6-8` – There are no Open Graph or Twitter tags (`og:title`, `og:description`, `og:url`, `og:image`, `og:type`). Fix: add them to the layout.

**Medium (GEO and content)**
8. `src/index.njk:7`, `src/team.njk:6`, `src/services.njk:9` – Claims with no evidence or specifics, which makes them hard for AI engines to cite. Examples: "Trusted by thousands", "decades of experience", "Our prices are simple and clear" (no actual prices). Fix: use concrete facts, such as named dentists with GDC numbers and qualifications, real prices or price ranges, and years established. Give each treatment its own descriptive content.
9. Site-wide – Structured data exists only on the contact page. Fix: put `Dentist`/`LocalBusiness` and `WebSite` JSON-LD in the layout. Add `Person` or `Physician` markup on the team page, and `Service`/`MedicalProcedure` markup on the services page. Add `FAQPage` if you add Q&A content.
10. `src/contact.njk:8` – `data-nosnippet` hides the insurance terms from snippets and AI answers. That is arguably fine for legal text, but insurance is a common patient question, so confirm it is intentional. Otherwise remove it and state the insurance info clearly.
11. `src/_includes/base.njk:12` – The nav is the only internal linking, and the home page links to services only. Add breadcrumbs and a footer with the address, phone number and opening hours (NAP) on every page.

**Low / config**
12. `src/robots.txt:1-3`, `geo.config.json:1` – The policy says AI search crawlers are allowed, and `User-agent: *` with `Allow: /` does allow them. But nothing names GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot or Google-Extended, so the policy isn't explicit or auditable. Fix: add explicit groups that match the policy.
13. `src/sitemap.xml:3-6` – It is static, with no `<lastmod>`, and it will drift from the pages. `thanks` is correctly left out. Fix: generate it from Eleventy collections with `lastmod`.
14. Missing files – There is no `llms.txt`, no 404 page and no favicon. `llms.txt` is optional but cheap to add.
15. `src/thanks.njk:5` – The `noindex` here is correct. Also add `nofollow`, and use `noindex, follow` in the layout.
16. `src/_includes/base.njk:6` – Titles are `{{ title }} | Brightside Dental`. The home title ("Family dentist in Leeds | Brightside Dental") is fine, but `Contact | ...` and `Thanks | ...` carry no keyword or location. Add "Leeds" to the contact title.

The three Critical items fix the biggest problems and are quick to do. Want me to apply them?
